Hi Sam / Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciated the honest rundown of your latency targets and data residency constraints. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned: 

- What we heard: 300ms P95 inference target for customer-facing flows, PV architecture on GCP with EU data residency for EU users, and a ~Q3 pilot scope of ~5M tokens/day.
- Risks: on-prem connector requirement for ACH data, and internal security review (SOC 2 evidence) that you mentioned.

Proposed next steps:
1) I’ll share a short scope + pilot approach (attached) mapping to your targets.
2) Dylan (cc’d) will follow up with a quick tech write-up covering expected latency optimizations and recommended instance sizing.
3) Stephanie (cc’d) can outline our onboarding and success plan + estimated CS touch.

Are you available next week for a 30-min technical sync (Dylan + Stephanie + your infra lead) to validate the pilot plan? I’ve proposed some times in the attached doc but happy to work around your calendar.

Attaching discovery notes and a draft scope for your review.

[Attachment: discovery_notes.pdf (PDF, 122 KB)]
